name: smwblocks-better-timer-passable-block-v2
title: Better Timer Passable Block v2.0
description:
This solid block will become passable when a specific timer (default: blue P-Switch, look in the .asm) isn't zero.

Unlike other timer conditional solid blocks, this one will not become solid when the player is inside the block; it keeps the timer from hitting zero. This makes it impossible to die or zip quickly downwards through the floor.
